fair_value_reason: Weighted methods at the 2027-10-14 horizon on 536.4M diluted share-equivalents (SBC counted once, as dilution), horizon net cash $3,256M, operating units $2,100M and the Series A/B/C warrant claim solved per state: (a) rNPV tree $10.02 x 0.30 + (b) TAM states $10.56 x 0.20 + (e) cash floor + option $11.43 x 0.20 + (f) Quantinuum mark $19.83 x 0.15 + (d) SOTP with computing at IonQ's acquisition cost $12.83 x 0.15 = 3.006 + 2.112 + 2.286 + 2.975 + 1.925 = $12.30 (post-gate 2026-10-14: p(S1) 0.80 -> 0.75 moves (a) $10.15 -> $10.02 and (e) $11.59 -> $11.43; was $12.37). Reverse DCF (c) and peer EV/sales are diagnostics with weight 0. Round-2 changes: units $2,450M -> $2,100M (SkyWater external revenue ~$410M per IonQ's guidance; Elisity at $600M), Series A/B expiries from R23, QNT at $33.51.
supervisor_summary: IonQ's value at the horizon is mostly cash and acquired businesses: ~536M diluted share-equivalents carry ~$3.3B of net cash and ~$2.1B of operating units, a floor of ~$9.6 a share after the 179M warrants. Five non-multiple methods put the computing roadmap at $0.2-6.1B, for a fair value of ~$12.3 against $31.5 today; the price needs computing worth ~$12.5B, about 26% of McKinsey's 2035 market with certainty. The five revised forecasts now agree on the filed facts (fair values $11.3-13.3), so I leave the ladder at their mean, shifted by the post-gate fair-value ratio 12.30/12.37 (median ~$21, P(>= spot) ~0.28): sector sentiment at 92% realized volatility (run brief), not fundamentals, drives the next 12 months. Defense exposure is undisclosed: up to ~40% of IonQ standalone revenue is U.S. government, ~44% at most with SkyWater.
key_drivers: Dilution is set by filings: 408.9M shares on 2026-10-13 + 50M from the 2026-10-14 units + ~34.8M Elisity shares at the $33.07 floor (close expected Q4 2026) take share-equivalents to ~536M at the horizon, with 179M warrants at $69.46-$155 (to 2032-2033) as a claim on top (424B5, Elisity 8-K and press release, 10-Q R22/R23).
Cash is the floor: ~$3.8B now and ~$3.3B at the horizon after ~$0.55B of non-SBC cash use, $6.07 per share; with operating units at ~$2.1B the floor is ~$9.6 after warrants.

SkyWater is worth less than its gross revenue suggests: IonQ's guidance nets out intercompany sales, implying ~$410M/yr of external revenue against a ~$626M gross run-rate; we value it at ~$1.0B against ~$2.05B paid.

The computing roadmap carries the rest: the market implies ~$12.5B for computing (~26% of McKinsey's $57B 2035 market, with certainty), while the roadmap tree gives ~$0.2-1.2B and the Quantinuum mark ~$6.1B. The 2027 tests are Superion 256 customer deliveries (no full-system fidelity published yet) and the 10,000-qubit chip.

Sector sentiment: QNT and IONQ are ~61-63% below their 52-week highs at 92% one-year realized volatility (run brief); how much of the premium persists, not fundamentals, sets most of the 12-month distribution.
